coach.header.subtitle: Your Health Coach
coach.step1.question: Do you want me to help you?
coach.step1.context: I looked at your results. What you are going through is real — and it is fixable. But only if you actually want to change something.
coach.step2.question: Will you follow my recommendations — even when it feels hard?
coach.step2.context: I will not ask you to quit your job or turn your life upside down. But I will ask you to do one specific thing each week. That is the deal.
coach.step2.yes: Yes, I will follow your guidance
coach.step3.question: Will you be honest with me — even when it is uncomfortable?
coach.step3.context: I can only help with what I actually know. The more honest you are, the better your plan will be. That is all I ask.
coach.step3.yes: Yes, I will be honest with you
coach.name.context: Before we start — I want to know who I am talking to. Not an email. Not a username.
coach.name.subtitle: one more thing
coach.name.question: What should I call you?
coach.committed: You are committed, {{name}}. Let us figure this out together.
coach.chat.opening:
Hi {{name}}. Let us start.

One question — and I want you to be specific:

What is taking the most out of you right now? Not what you think you should say. What is actually draining you.
